mentions.name: Collins KW-1 transmitter restoration
mentions.description: This is a hardware restoration project bringing a friend's vintage Collins KW-1 transmitter (serial number 1) back into working condition after a long period of disuse, which involved troubleshooting wiring and bolt connections that failed to conduct electricity.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently a friend acquired a Collins KW-1 transmitter, serial number 1. I helped him get it working again after a long period of disuse by it's previous owner. You wouldn't believe how often it turns out that wires and bolts don't actually conduct electricity.
